title: Determine Equivalent Ratios Using Tables
focus: Use ratio tables to generate equivalent ratios

items.stem: Which of the following ratios is equivalent to 3:5?
A ratio table shows the ratio 2:7 in the first row. Which of the following rows correctly continues the table with an equivalent ratio?
Select ALL the statements that correctly explain why two ratios are equivalent. Show or explain your work.
choices: They have the same simplified form.
The numerator of one is double the numerator of the other, and the denominator is double as well.
Both ratios represent the same fraction when written as one number divided by the other.
The numerators are the same but the denominators differ by 1.

items.stem: Use a ratio table to determine whether the ratio 4:9 is equivalent to 8:18. Show or explain your work.
